items.known: CKV_AWS_51 Ensure ECR Image Tags are immutable (resource aws_ecr_repository.repository)
items.remediation: Set image_tag_mutability = "IMMUTABLE" to prevent tags from being overwritten once pushed

items.known: CKV_AWS_163 Ensure ECR image scanning on push is enabled (resource aws_ecr_repository.repository)
items.issue: Image scanning on push not enabled
items.remediation: Add an image_scanning_configuration block with scan_on_push = true inside the aws_ecr_repository resource

items.known: CKV_AWS_136 Ensure that ECR repositories are encrypted using KMS (resource aws_ecr_repository.repository)
items.remediation: Add an encryption_configuration block with encryption_type = "KMS" and specify a kms_key referencing a customer-managed AWS KMS key
